data.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one 2x2 animation sprite sheet for a 2D game attack FX, using the provided jellyfish avatar as visual reference for identity, palette, material language, and attack personality: cute translucent jellyfish hero aesthetic, rounded glassy bell inspiration, lavender-blue body colors, pink-violet highlights, cyan rim glow, tiny bubble accents, soft candy-like underwater magic. This is an attack FX sheet only, not a character body sheet.

Canvas: one clean HD 2D game FX sprite sheet, exactly 4 equal cells arranged 2 rows x 2 columns. Background must be 100% solid flat magenta #FF00FF across the entire sheet including all spaces between cells. No visible grid lines, no borders, no labels, no text, no numbers, no arrows, no watermark. Each frame centered in its cell, same visual scale and similar bounding box, generous magenta margin on all four sides. No FX element may cross or touch any cell edge.

Style: project-native clean HD 2D game FX, crisp readable silhouette, smooth hand-painted glow, glossy translucent jelly material, polished underwater fantasy look, cute and soft rather than harsh. Not pixel art. Do not draw the jellyfish character; no full creature, no eyes, no face, no body, no card, no UI.

Frame content:
Top-left frame 1: compact wind-up, small translucent cyan bubble ring with faint pink-violet electric threads curling inward, soft jelly glow beginning to form.
Top-right frame 2: sting release, several short wavy jellyfish-tentacle lightning arcs snap forward, cyan-white cores with lavender and pink edges, small pearl bubbles trailing behind.
Bottom-left frame 3: peak paralysis impact, bright rounded aqua-white flash shaped like a soft jelly bloom, radial wavy tendril sparks, tiny candy-like star glints and bubbles, energetic but cute.
Bottom-right frame 4: fading afterimage, translucent violet-blue jelly arcs dissolve into drifting bubbles and a faint circular ripple, readable but gentle.

Ensure exactly four frames only, one continuous jellyfish sting attack effect, no character or facial elements.
